name: Taupe
source:
The merchant's daughter, Alisha, was bedridden with a serious illness.
One moonless night, she wakes up due to a suffocation.
But no one is there, except her.
The moment Alisha wakes up again after losing her consciousness, she found herself in a strange room.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7521]official site[/url]]
translation:
商人的女儿艾莉莎身患重病，卧床不起。
一个没有月亮的夜晚，她因窒息而惊醒。
然而，四下无人，只有她自己。
再次失去意识后，当艾莉莎醒来时，发现自己身处一个陌生的房间。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7521]官网[/url]]
